tx:
The following actions give a chance to receive this item:
• Disassembling items
• Siphoning (including mechanised siphons) augmented items
• Making devices at an invention workbench
• Filling gizmos
• Creating unstable effigies
The following actions will not give a chance to receive this item:
• Playing a minigame that rewards experience in this skill
• Using protean cogs or unstable protean cogs

The chance is not affected by experience boosters.
In a purely mathematical format, the chance f of receiving the pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{(B / 180) \times S}{50,000,000}
Where:
• B is the base experience per action
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 200 is applied to this value
